# portfolio-web — full context for LLMs

## Identity

Personal portfolio for Dinesh K N. Production: https://www.dineshkn.site. Stack: Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, Tailwind 3, client-side HUD.

## Agent entrypoints

1. AGENTS.md — operational instructions (commands, boundaries)
2. docs/AGENTS-REFERENCE.md — deep dive
3. .cursor/rules/*.mdc — Cursor scoped rules

## Shell architecture

RootLayout → HudShell → HudProvider (state) → HudNav, HudFrame, ReactorBackdrop, lazy overlays (BootSequence, CursorLayer, ReactorCanvas if opt-in) → main → ModuleTransition → page content.

State: booting, sfx, use3D (localStorage hud-reactor-3d=true AND 6+ CPU cores).

## Routes and content

| Path | Content file | Notes |
|------|----------------|-------|
| / | app/home/HomeContent.js | Typewriter deferred; lazy DraggableStat |
| /skills | app/skills/SkillsContent.js | Bento grid + inspect panel |
| /about | app/about/AboutContent.js | 3-col chronos bridge, viewport locked |
| /projects | app/projects/ProjectsContent.js | Strip + stage, viewport locked |
| /contact | app/contact/ContactContent.js | Formspree POST |

All module pages use components/hud/ModulePage.js. Data: lib/site-content.js.

## Performance defaults

- CSS reactor only; WebGL opt-in
- No framer-motion in shell; CSS hud-panel-swap for panel changes
- No GSAP/cmdk in initial shell bundle (dynamic import)
- Fonts: Space Grotesk + IBM Plex Mono
- npm run perf:full → perf-reports/latest.json

## Commands

npm install | dev | build | start | lint | perf | perf:full | dev:perf

## Do not

Commit without ask; force-push; add secrets; always-on WebGL; horizontal route enter animations; backdrop-filter on HUD cards without perf review.
